name: residency-working-set

protocol.note: Allocations stay at 16–64 bytes; the experiment never approaches physical RAM. (1) whole-arena-universe sets ExecutionPlan::working_set_budget without a lease: requested bytes are the sum of every Active allocation->size (two 16-byte actives = 32). A budget of 16 refuses with 'working-set budget exceeded' -- never a silent clamp, never 'unified memory is infinite'. (2) hand-picked-lease names one 16-byte allocation under a 64-byte budget and succeeds; reported requested bytes differ from the Universe row on the same arena. (3) discovery-lease calls core::discover_reachable from a seed in one of two 16-byte actives (the seed has no outgoing PointerRef), fills WorkingSetLease from that reachable set, and submits under budget 16 -- requested=16, not Universe 32. A fake subset is not invented. (4) sparse is LoweringClass::Unsupported (Metal sparse heap/texture is not implemented; Vulkan sparse binding is compile-review-only explicit map/unmap, not automatic page fault). working_set_requested / working_set_committed / working_set_proxy are separate LoweringReport events; reasons say 'proxy' because there is no OS residency counter. This is not E016: max_in_flight_representations is representation-version cardinality, not this-submit residency.

correctness.oracle: arithmetic: hand-picked lease of one 16-byte allocation under budget 64 succeeds with requested=16; Universe of two 16-byte actives under budget 16 refuses with 'working-set budget exceeded' and requested=32; the two requested figures differ; a default plan (no budget, no lease) still succeeds and emits no working-set events
correctness.tolerance: exact (integer byte counts and the stable WorkingSetBudget::allows error string)

variant_status.discovery-lease: implemented (core::discover_reachable; seed-only subset of a two-allocation arena)

judgement: Address graph and this-submit residency are separate: a hand-picked WorkingSetLease or a discover_reachable lease can stay inside a budget that Universe of the same arena exceeds. A set ExecutionPlan::working_set_budget is a hard refuse via WorkingSetBudget::allows ('working-set budget exceeded'), not a clamp and not an implicit enlarge. Reported bytes are request/commit/proxy, each labelled proxy because this host has no public OS residency counter (06 §10). Metal sparse is honest Unsupported. Physical-RAM pressure and an OS residency counter are unmeasured. Vulkan sparse is compile-review-only commentary that sparse binding is explicit map/unmap, not automatic fault (ADR-024/030/037/041).
vulkan_status: compile-review-only (ADR-024/030/037/041); no Vulkan sparse runtime and no working-set submit hook were added (sparse ≠ automatic fault; no Vulkan hardware reachable on this host)
